name: Kagi
description: Kagi search and its summarizer, from a paid Kagi account.
long_description:
Kagi's hosted server: search their index, and summarise a page or a video with their summariser.

Bring a Kagi API token. Kagi's search API is paid per call, so this is a connector that spends money — a little, per search, and the README says so plainly.

auth.instructions: Create an API token in Kagi's settings and paste it here. Kagi's search API is billed per call.

risk.notes: Reads the public web through Kagi. Every search is billed to your Kagi account.
